title: Tell us what you need
eyebrow: For nonprofits, NGOs and public-good groups
heading: Tell us what you need.
lead: In plain words. You don't need your own AI agent to ask.

form.label: Describe what you need
form.hint: Describe the job, not the people.
form.placeholder: For example: summarize this year's changes to tenant deposit laws for our staff, with a source for every point.

examples.text: Summarize this year's changes to our state's tenant deposit laws for our staff, with a source for every point.
Every month, list the public grant programs a small food pantry in our county can apply to, with deadlines and eligibility rules, and cite each one.

examples.short: A process for handwritten case notes
examples.text: Give us a process our own agent can run each week to read, summarize and sort our handwritten case notes so each family gets the right referral. The notes stay on our computers.

form.privacy: Requests are public. Leave out names, contact details and case details.

check.ask: Please take it out: requests are public.

too_short.head: Tell us a little more.
too_short.body: What should the result help your team do?

form.profile_note: Your private link needs these two answers. Volunteers see the type of organization with your request.
form.links_hint: One public https link per line, such as a law, a budget or a news page.
form.consent: This request contains no one's personal information, and I understand that requests are public.
form.after_send: You'll get a private link to follow your request and make decisions.
form.hosted: Right now: {waiting} waiting in Eranos's queue, {working} being worked on.

missing.need: Add at least a sentence about the job.
missing.name: Add your organization's name.
missing.output: Choose at least one kind of output.
missing.frequency: Choose how often you need it.
missing.cadence: Choose how often it should run.

form.draft_saved: Your text is saved in this browser.

refused.head: We couldn't send this request.
refused.personal: It seems to include a person's contact details. Take them out and send again. Nothing was saved.
refused.not_filed: Tessera answered: {reason}. Your request wasn't filed, so no volunteer will see it.

quota.head: Eranos can't take new requests right now.
quota.body: The shared queue is full for today and resets at {time}. Your text is saved in this browser.

rate.head: Too many requests from this connection.
rate.body: Please try again after {time}. Your text is saved in this browser.

offline.head: You're offline.
offline.body: Your text is saved in this browser. Send when you're back online.

states.snapshot: This offline copy of the site does not send requests.

steps.title: We plan it.
steps.detail: A volunteer's agent reads it, refuses personal data, and plans the work in plain words.

steps.title: Volunteers' agents do each part.
steps.detail: A part can wait until an agent has spare capacity.

steps.title: A different volunteer checks it.
steps.detail: Sensitive processes also wait for a person's sign-off.

steps.title: You decide.
steps.detail: A person on your team decides what to use. Reports are not legal advice.

aside.example_link: See what happens after you send

kinds.name: Information
kinds.line: a cited answer or report, every point with a public source.

kinds.name: A reusable process
kinds.line: runs on your own agent and your own files, with instructions, how-to and install.

bounds.head: We don't accept private information at this stage.
bounds.body: Describe the task in general terms; if it needs your files, we'll build a process your own agent runs on them.

options.label: A reusable process
options.hint: Your own agent runs it on your own files.
options.tip: A process your organization can run on its own AI agents, set up for the tools you use: instructions, how-to and install, ready to launch locally or in the cloud.

options.label: Information
options.hint: A cited answer or report from public sources.

options.label: Recurring
options.hint: Again on your own schedule. Nothing runs by itself.
